Our story

From inherited wisdom to an everyday ritual.

I’m Maya Rao, the founder of PIYA.

My relationship with skincare became personal as my skin grew more sensitive. I wanted products that felt gentle and effective, with clean ingredients and a lighter impact on the earth, yet nothing felt quite right. The answer took me back to my mother.

Her skin was naturally healthy, cared for with simple ingredients from the kitchen and Ayurvedic practices passed through generations. Turmeric was part of her daily ritual, valued for its purifying and calming qualities. The ritual was beautiful, but its colour and preparation did not always fit the pace of modern life.

I began exploring concentrated botanical extracts that could preserve the spirit and benefits of those traditions in stable, practical formulas. That meeting of inherited knowledge and thoughtful formulation became PIYA.

PIYA means beloved—a tribute to where we come from, and to the care we choose to carry forward.

We select natural and organic ingredients for purity, performance and responsibility, working with partners who share our respect for the earth. Rooted in tradition and guided by science, each PIYA ritual is made to nourish skin naturally.

Purpose, always

Care should extend beyond the skincare shelf.

Purpose shapes every decision we make. PIYA donates soap and supports nonprofit work addressing hygiene poverty, helping everyday care reach more people and communities.

With love,

Maya Rao

Founder, PIYA BEAUTY LLC
